name: What factors determine the cost of door adjustment and repair?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of door adjustment and repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to adjust or repair a door depends on whether the issue is simple hardware wear or a deeper framing problem. A straightforward service call to tighten hinges, plane an edge, or adjust a strike plate costs significantly less than rebuilding an out-of-square jamb. Factors that increase labor include fixing rotted wood, removing and reinstalling custom molding, repairing cracked drywall around the opening, or refitting non-standard doors. Combining multiple door adjustments into a single handyman visit is often more economical than scheduling one door at a time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on whether the fix requires simple hinge adjustments or full jamb re-shimming, custom trim removal, and drywall patching around the opening.
